b11.detail: b11 join_in type 'camera' pans across empty canvas from the presenter station; change to 'cut' (scene file cannot set the join). (reported by scene)

[major] The camera transition from presenter to coffee corner pans across empty canvas space, leaving an almost completely blank beige frame at mid-join (118.35s). (suggested fix: In storyboard for beat b11, change join_in.type from 'camera' to 'cut' to eliminate the empty pan across disconnected stations.)
